items.title: ICICI Pru AMC Q4 results: Profit rises 10% YoY to Rs 763 cr; co declares Rs 12.4 dividend
items.description: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company reported 10% YoY Q4 profit growth to Rs 763 crore, driven by higher revenue and improved operating leverage. Annual earnings rose strongly, though sequential profit declined due to lower income despite controlled expenses.
